positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description: I worked in the data science team to help small to medium-sized banks learn more about their customers and target potential customers in their area.

positions.title: Robotics Intern
positions.description:
Worked on the main robotics project of the lab, TeleBot—a humanoid, 6’ tall robot on two wheels that is remotely controlled by a human operator.
	
Navigation Team (Team Leader)
-Managed a team of developers tasked with making TeleBot move and balance on two wheels.
-Developed the navigation system alongside team members and wrote daily progress reports.
-Conducted research on the physics of inverted pendulum robots and designed control loop balancing algorithms to be implemented based on my findings.
-Created a safe testing environment for the robot’s navigation system.

Hand Team
-Programmed microcontrollers in the human operator’s gloves and the robot’s hands so that the operator’s hand movements would be mirrored in the robot’s hands.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Student
positions.description:
Funded by the Department of Defense and the National Science Foundation.
Conducted research on dynamic balancing systems for two-wheeled robots, documented my findings, and presented my research to university professors.

projects.title: Java GlusterFS
projects.description: An open source project that aims to provide a complete implementation of Java 7's NIO.2 file system API so as to aid Java developers in using Red Hat's GlusterFS and its API in their applications.

projects.title: Colon Rendering for Medical Research
projects.description: Data gathered from a patient's colonoscopy exam is used to render a colon in 3D and provide an internal and external view of the organ, with the aim of allowing doctors to traverse the organ for diagnostic purposes.
